snippet.title: PlayStation - Tenchi o Kurau II - Sekiheki no Tatakai (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Tenchi o Kurau II: Sekiheki no Tatakai is an Action game, published by Capcom, which was released in Japan in 1996.
